attributes.title: post-curation-processing/main
attributes.description: Post-curation processing workflow for VGP assemblies. Takes a curated AGP file and combined haplotype FASTA, splits by haplotype, applies curation, assigns chromosome names, renames and reorients hap2 to match hap1, then generates QC outputs including Compleasm, Pretext maps, telomere analysis, and coverage tracks.

attributes.title: histological-staining-area-quantification/histological-staining-area-quantification
attributes.description: This workflow performs colour deconvolution and automated thresholding to quantify stained area in brightfield histological images (MT, IHC). It accepts whole slides or pre-cropped ROIs.

inputs.name: ROI image for staining analysis
inputs.description: Brightfield histological image (whole slide or pre-cropped ROI) for staining quantification. Compatible stainings include Masson's Trichrome and IHC. Accepted format: TIFF.

outputs.name: Collection: Individual Deconvolved Channels
source_ids: Split Image Channels for Staining Detection

outputs.name: Selected Stain Channel
source_ids: Collection: Extract Stain Channel from Sub-Collections

outputs.id: Collection of Tabular: Staining Quantification Results
outputs.name: Collection of Tabular: Staining Quantification Results

steps.name: Color Deconvolution
steps.description:
Performs colour deconvolution using the H-E-DAB (HED) transformation, separating the image into individual stain channels. Channel 1 = Hematoxylin, Channel 2 = Eosin/target stain, Channel 3 = Residuals. Higher pixel intensity indicates lower stain concentration.
toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/imgteam/color_deconvolution/ip_color_deconvolution/0.9+galaxy0

steps.name: Split Image Channels for Staining Detection
steps.description:
Splits multi-channel image into single-channel images. Extracts the target stain channel from the split image collection. Default index: 1 (Channel 2). Verify this corresponds to your stain of interest before running the workflow. The pixel data type is preserved.
toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/imgteam/split_image/ip_split_image/2.3.5+galaxy0

steps.name: Collection: Extract Stain Channel from Sub-Collections
steps.description:
This step extracts the second image (usually the relevant stain channel) from each sub-collection in a collection of collections. Please verify the selected channel is correct before proceeding. The current index is set to extract dataset 2.
__EXTRACT_DATASET__

steps.name: Threshold Stain Channel Collection
steps.description:
Applies a threshold to the selected stain channel to segment stained areas for quantification.
Tool only process tiff files with 1 channel. 
toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/imgteam/2d_auto_threshold/ip_threshold/0.25.2+galaxy0

steps.name: Generate ROIs of stained region
steps.description:
This step detects CD11b positive regions from the binary mask and generates polygon ROIs for each stained blob. ROIs can be uploaded to OMERO for visual validation of the threshold.
toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/imgteam/imagej2_analyze_particles_binary/imagej2_analyze_particles_binary/20240614+galaxy0

steps.name: Extract Image Features
steps.description:
Extracts quantitative features (e.g., mean intensity) from the thresholded image to support staining analysis.


toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/imgteam/2d_feature_extraction/ip_2d_feature_extraction/0.25.2+galaxy1

steps.name: Prepare Header Source Dataset
steps.description:
Extracts a dataset that will be used to obtain the header row for the final concatenated tabular file in a subsequent step.
__EXTRACT_DATASET__

steps.name: Header Extraction
steps.description:
Extracting header from source dataset to use in the final tabular file. 
Show beginning1

steps.name: Collapse Collection into one file
steps.description:
Allows to collapse a collection of tabular files with the individual samples quantification into one tabular file. 
toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/nml/collapse_collections/collapse_dataset/5.1.0

steps.name: Paste header with Sample ID
steps.description:
Combined the Sample ID with the header of the remaining columns.
Paste1

steps.name: Paste Sample Names with Tabular Results
steps.description:
This step joins a list of sample names with their corresponding quantification results. It pastes both files side by side, ensuring that each sample name is aligned with the correct row of the quantification table.
Paste1

steps.name: Tabular: Staining Feature Results
steps.description:
This final output file contains the merged measurement results for all samples, and can be used for further statistical analysis.
cat1

steps.name: Percent area computation
steps.description:
Computes the proportion of positive signal area relative to total image area, expressed as percentage.
toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/devteam/column_maker/Add_a_column1/2.1+galaxy0
